review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform & DevSecOps)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About The Role The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, automates, and maintains high-availability, fault-tolerant, and secure infrastructure powering digital financial products (e.g., nano-finance, consumer finance, e-payments, digital insurance brokerage). The engineer is responsible for embedding DevSecOps pipelines, automated compliance controls, immutable audit logging, and Disaster Recovery (DR) automation into every layer of the cloud and on-premise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities DevSecO
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field. Regulatory & Security Understanding Proven track record working under strict InfoSec oversight (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or central bank/financial regulator standards); familiarity with Egypt's data privacy (PDPL 151/2020) and FRA IT requirements. Hands-On Depth Strong troubleshooting acumen across Linux kernel internals, TCP/IP networking, DNS, TLS/SSL termination, and distributed systems performance tuning.
